Nadia, I've posted the Vantorre Group ticket list as a reply in your thread in #strategic-pod. I found three ticket numbers:

1. **#8841** (also written #PD-8841) shows up in #strategic-pod (Gideon, 2026-07-01) and in Moss's 4/27, 5/4 and 9/30 digests. The details disagree between sources: Allentown versus Newark, different doors and different symptoms. The 9/30 digest has it submitted after the July message says it was closed. Support would need to confirm whether it's one ticket or more than one.
2. **INC-4821** is in #inc-vtg-hartford (Gideon, 2026-08-03). It covers the status-page access issue.
3. **VT-55120** is in #inc-vtg-hartford (Gideon, 2026-10-14). It's the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage.

I left out Mobility's #4812. I also left out #PD-4418 (Moss digest 2025-09-15) because it says "the account Nadia runs" without naming Vantorre. If that was Vantorre Group, it belongs on the list.

I could only see these references in the channels and digests. I can't open the tickets, so I can't vouch for their status or contents.
